focus.title: 欧盟碳边境调节机制过渡期收官在即，中国出口企业须完成嵌入排放数据核验
focus.summary: 欧盟CBAM过渡期将于2026年底结束，2027年起进入正式征收阶段。近期欧盟委员会加强对进口商季度报告的合规审查，钢铁、铝、水泥、化肥等六大行业中国出口商被要求提供经核验的产品嵌入排放数据。企业若无法提供实际数据，将按欧盟默认值计税，成本显著上升。建议出口企业尽快建立产品级碳足迹台账，与欧盟进口商核对申报口径，并评估在合同中约定碳成本分担条款的必要性。
focus.source: 来源：欧盟委员会税务与海关同盟总司 · 2026.10.26
focus.title_en: EU CBAM Transitional Period Nears Its End: Chinese Exporters Must Complete Verified Embedded Emissions Data
focus.summary_en: The EU's CBAM transitional period closes at the end of 2026, with the definitive levy regime starting in 2027. The European Commission has recently stepped up compliance scrutiny of importers' quarterly reports, requiring Chinese exporters in the steel, aluminium, cement and fertiliser sectors to supply verified product-level embedded emissions data. Absent actual data, EU default values will apply, sharply raising costs. Exporters should build product-level carbon footprints, align reporting methodologies with EU importers, and consider contractual carbon-cost-sharing clauses.
focus.source_en: Source: European Commission, DG Taxation and Customs Union · 2026.10.26

case.title: 新加坡国际商事法庭承认与执行中国法院商事判决，跨境债权回收路径再拓宽
case.summary: 新加坡国际商事法庭近期在一起中资企业跨境货款纠纷中，依据《选择法院协议公约》精神及中新司法合作实践，承认并执行了中国内地法院作出的生效商事判决。该案要点在于：双方合同明确约定中国法院管辖，且判决程序符合正当程序要求。对出海企业的启示是，在跨境合同中约定明确的管辖条款并保留送达与程序证据，可显著提升境外执行的可预期性；同时应评估对方资产所在地是否具备承认执行基础。
case.source: 来源：新加坡国际商事法庭相关公开案例综述 · 2026年10月
case.title_en: Singapore International Commercial Court Recognises and Enforces Chinese Commercial Judgment, Widening Cross-Border Debt Recovery
case.summary_en: The Singapore International Commercial Court recently recognised and enforced a final commercial judgment of a mainland Chinese court in a cross-border payment dispute involving a Chinese company, consistent with the spirit of the Choice of Court Agreements Convention and China-Singapore judicial cooperation. Key points: the contract contained a clear Chinese court jurisdiction clause and the proceedings met due-process standards. The lesson for outbound businesses is to secure clear jurisdiction and service evidence in cross-border contracts, and to assess whether the counterparty's asset location supports recognition and enforcement.
case.source_en: Source: Review of publicly reported SICC cases · October 2026

policy.title: 粤港澳大湾区跨境数据流动便利化措施扩围，涉外企业合规路径进一步明晰
policy.summary: 粤港澳大湾区近期进一步扩展跨境数据流动便利化安排，覆盖金融、医疗、贸易物流等重点领域，允许符合条件的企业通过标准合同、安全评估等路径实现数据出境。同时，内地与香港就个人信息出境认证机制持续对接。对跨境企业而言，应梳理数据资产地图，区分个人信息与重要数据，选择适配的出境路径并完成备案；涉及境外接收方的，应在合同中明确数据安全与审计义务。
policy.source: 来源：国家网信办及广东省相关公开政策信息 · 2026年10月
policy.title_en: Greater Bay Area Cross-Border Data Flow Facilitation Expanded, Clarifying Compliance Paths for Foreign-Related Enterprises
policy.summary_en: The Greater Bay Area has further expanded facilitation arrangements for cross-border data flows in finance, healthcare and trade logistics, allowing qualifying enterprises to transfer data abroad via standard contracts or security assessments. Meanwhile, mutual recognition of personal information export certification between the mainland and Hong Kong continues. Companies should map data assets, distinguish personal from important data, select the appropriate export route and complete filings, and specify data-security and audit obligations in contracts with overseas recipients.
policy.source_en: Source: Public policy information from the Cyberspace Administration of China and Guangdong authorities · October 2026

analysis.title: 秦林蒿律师研判：供应链尽调须前置，出口管制与制裁筛查应嵌入交易全流程
analysis.summary: 秦林蒿律师研判：近期多国出口管制与制裁清单更新频繁，企业仅靠签约前一次性筛查已不足以应对风险。建议将受限方筛查、最终用途与最终用户核查嵌入采购、物流、收款各环节，形成可留痕的动态合规机制；对高风险交易设置中止与退出条款，并在合同中约定合规陈述保证与违约救济。同时保留筛查记录，以备监管问询时证明已尽合理审慎义务。
analysis.source: 来源：律连全球 · iGlobal Law 编辑部 · 2026.10.26
analysis.title_en: Attorney Qin's view: Supply-Chain Due Diligence Must Come First—Embed Export-Control and Sanctions Screening Across the Entire Transaction
analysis.summary_en: Attorney Qin's view: With export-control and sanctions lists updated frequently across jurisdictions, a one-off pre-signing check is no longer sufficient. Companies should embed restricted-party screening and end-use/end-user verification into procurement, logistics and payment processes, creating a traceable, dynamic compliance mechanism. High-risk transactions should carry suspension and exit clauses, with compliance representations and remedies built into contracts. Retain screening records to demonstrate reasonable diligence if regulators inquire.
